approach-hard-coded-stage-2.reason: A fixed Stage 2 path silently omits future active harnesses and can lose coverage when that path moves.

forces: Existing required context names and independent baseline/candidate governance must remain intact.
approach-new-required-job.reason: A new job is not required until branch protection changes; the existing stable repository concern already owns this tooling.

evidence_ids: Runner fixture tests require all active harness suites, reject missing suites and symbolic links, exclude archive and report no harness explicitly.
A planted failing fixture produces a nonzero command result; its passing null control succeeds; the real active suites execute without claiming a run.
Workflow diff retains the existing design-pattern-governance context and the dual check records baseline and candidate results separately.

security_justification.audit_integrity: Required fixture checks protect accounting and observation controls before a bounded approved run is spent.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: CI executes fixtures only and grants no Stage 2 S1 or production authority.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The new required check is assessed before implementation; existing owner decisions and exact-head approvals retain their meaning.
security_justification.concurrency: Suites may exercise fixture concurrency; the runner bounds its child and propagates termination.
security_justification.confidentiality: No new secret is introduced or made available; existing CI permissions remain.
security_justification.cryptography: No key, signature or digest algorithm changes; approval and kit hashes remain untouched.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Discovery names repository-relative paths and retains test diagnostics without introducing credential handling.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security service is added; existing required contexts stay stable.
security_justification.fail_posture: Missing suites, discovery errors, launch failures and failing tests fail closed; absence of all active harnesses is visibly not applicable.
security_justification.lifecycle: Fold and archive are separate PRs; CI self-tests never spend the governed probe run ledger.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Only the assessed runner, its tests, the CI step and owning specification lifecycle paths change.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Fixture inputs remain synthetic; no collection or privacy transformation is added.
security_justification.resource_retention: Fixture temporary resources remain test-owned and bounded child execution prevents an unbounded runner wait.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No package retry semantics change; fixture retry checks are now executed by required CI.
security_justification.trust_boundary: CI gains a new population of fixture suites; archive exclusion and fail-closed discovery bound that population.
